title: BLUEPRINT map vocabulary
description: The closed sets an BLUEPRINT impact map is written in. Emitted from @bett3r-dev/blueprint-schema; do not hand-edit, and do not extend a set in a consumer.

mapNodeLevel.description: A node's level in the impact map; the who-level is spelled mapActor.

mapShape.description: How a map is drawn: impact columns or a decision tree.

exampleStatusKind.description: Where a scenario or observation stands; only a human agrees one.

kpiMode.description: Whether an observation defines a new KPI or references one the APM already tracks.

kpiDirection.description: Which way an observation expects its KPI to move.

kpiSourceKind.description: Where a defined KPI is read from: eventstorming ids, or a query on a logical datasource role.

kpiFilterOutcome.description: The logical outcome a KPI event side may be filtered on.

walkKind.description: Whether a fork option's walk describes behaviour or structure.
